say.speaker: starly
say.text: Good news, {name:caterpie}! I circled two ridges ahead and spotted a dry pine hollow for camp tonight.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Nice scouting, {name:starly}. Did you check the brush underneath, or just admire the view from the treetops?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey, I looked down! Mostly! Why, did you find something crawling along the trail?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Fresh thorn vines across the path, plus your spare pouch strap torn clean in half. Hand it here before you drop rations all over the kingdom.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Whoa, good eye! Just like when we used to climb the big oak back home and you caught every acorn I fumbled.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Hold still while I wind a silk knot around the buckle. Somebody has to keep your gear anchored to the ground.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Phew... those shale ledges slowed me down badly today, {name:starly}. You could have cleared the ambush twice while waiting on me.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: And leave my flank wide open? Not happening. You saw that crosswind near the crest.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Wait, you hovered back there because of the gust, not because you were bored?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: One tailwind nearly flipped me sideways into a boulder! If your silk line hadn't tagged that pine branch for me to grab, I'd be wearing dirt.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Heh. Even fast wings need a tether when the valley kicks up a gale.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Touché. Next steep climb, give a whistle and I'll drop low to cover the ridge while you haul up.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Deal. You watch the sky, and I'll keep the rocks from tripping you up.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: You've been staring at the clouds since we set the campfire, {name:caterpie}. Still thinking about that last canyon march?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: A little. Every road past the capital gets steeper and harsher. Back before my wings came in, I used to worry how long you'd have to keep slowing down for me.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey! Don't talk about yourself like that! Who held off two wild thugs in the brush while I regrouped?!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: I know, I just still remember scrambling to keep pace whenever trouble hit from the ridge.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Listen to me. I watched you inch up every wet branch back home before either of us knew how to fight. You never quit halfway.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: So whether we are scrambling along branches or riding high wind, I'm staying right beside your shoulder all the way.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Thank you, {name:starly}. One of these days, I'm still challenging you to a race all the way back to town.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Hold out your left talon for a second, {name:starly}. I spun this silver cord tight enough to shrug off sleet and briars.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Whoa, it catches the dawn light like frost! What's the occasion?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: A promise. Wherever this expedition takes us, if fog splits the squad, I'll know which shadow in the clouds is yours.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Then here's my side of the oath. This crest feather stays tucked in your satchel until you don't need a lookout anymore.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: No matter how far we climb or fly, I'll still need someone loud enough to keep me from overthinking every turn.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Count on it! Ground to sky, hometown to the far ends of the map, nobody breaks our line.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Wing to wing, {name:starly}. All the way home.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Almost done winding this medical silk onto the stick. Just one last loop and...

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Need a paw, {name:caterpie}?! I ran two laps around the camp clearing and I'm wide awake!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Bzzzt! Ack! {name:pawmi}, wait, don't grab the loose end with your cheeks sparking like that!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Eek! Why is the whole spool puffing up like a cotton ball?!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Static charge. My neat bandage roll now looks like a startled sheep.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Aw, man, I'm really sorry! Every time I hurry to help, my fur ruins the tidy stuff. Let me help untangle it!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Easy, easy. Sit on the flat stone for a minute and let the sparks ground out first, then we'll fix it together.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Okay, carrying the woven supply net, walking slow, holding my breath, zero sparks...

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: {name:pawmi}, you're puffing your cheeks out so hard you're trembling. Watch that root on your left!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Whoa! Crackle! Ow, tripped! Catch the net!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Got you! One silk snag around your waist, and the net is safe.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: I tried holding everything in, and it popped twice as loud when I stumbled. How do you stay so calm?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Don't bottle your charge up tight. Bleed the extra buzz off into a dry stick before you pick up thread, then move at your normal step.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Tap a stick first, then walk normal! Oh, that feels way better than clenching my ears shut!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Damp mountain mist soaked right through the pack straps again. My silk won't cure properly while the moss is this wet.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Hold on, {name:caterpie}. Set the spool on that flat rock and step back just a paw's length.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Huh? Wait, the air around the rock just turned toasty warm, and I didn't hear a single snap!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Heehee! I let the big spark drain into the gravel first, then kept just a tiny hum between my palms to dry the stone.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Not one frayed fiber. You've got real finesse under all that energy when you slow down, {name:pawmi}.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Best part? My cheeks don't even ache afterward! Guess pacing really does help on the trail too.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Okay, tripwire test number four! Lay the silk line across the clearing, {name:caterpie}.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Anchored to both pines. Ready for your pulse, {name:pawmi}.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: One gentle tap! Hear that? A clean low hum from end to end, and zero scorched leaves!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Any prowler brushing that thread will light up the whole perimeter before they reach camp!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: You know, if I'd charged out here alone, I'd have tripped my own ambush in five seconds flat. Having you steady my pace changed everything.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: And I'd still be sitting at the starting post overplanning if you hadn't dragged me into motion. We balance each other cleanly.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Then here's to our squad's best duo, {name:caterpie}! Wherever the road bends next, we hold the line together!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Still can't get over the look on everyone's faces when we crashed the capital gates! Best entrance ever, right, {name:starly}?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: You're welcome for the directions! Without me spotting their campfire smoke over the foothills, you'd still be sniffing gravel.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Excuse me?! Your smoke plume turned out to be a charcoal kiln! My nose tracked their boot prints and ration wrappers straight through the cave!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey, that kiln smelled very heroic from three hundred feet up! Besides, who dove into that Great Tusk dust cloud first?

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Me, by half a stride! And don't think I didn't notice your tail feathers smoking when that tusk swiped past!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Ha! Barely a scratch! Next big scrap, first one to tag the boss wins dinner.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Ow... okay, nobody's looking, right? My right wing feels like I carried a boulder across the valley.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Aha! I knew you pulled a muscle flapping non-stop up those cliffs to keep ahead of me!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Shh! Keep your voice down, {name:pawmi}! Wait... why are you wrapping a leaf around your hind paw?

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Okay, fine, I slid fifty feet down a gravel bank trying to beat you to the capital road. Blister the size of a Cheri Berry.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Ha! Two stubborn idiots limping into a royal battle like we owned the place.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: And we still pulled it off! Deal is nobody breathes a word to Master Quaquaval or the rest of the squad, got it?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Sealed tight. Now hurry up and heal that paw so I can dust you on tomorrow's march!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Look at how far back our hometown hills are now, {name:starly}. Just blue haze past the river.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Weird, isn't it? Back on the village pitch, folks laughed when we said we'd join a real expedition one day.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: They called us loud and way too quick to pick fights with bigger Pokemon.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Turns out loud and reckless was the exact ticket needed to cross a mountain range without a map.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Plus, when you dive high and I rush low, nobody gets a clean swing at either of us.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Here's the rule from now on, {name:pawmi}. No matter how wild the next realm gets, neither of us gets left behind.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Not a chance! High road and low road, crashing every gate together!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Whoosh! Ha! Beat that barrel roll, {name:combee}! Let's see all three of you spin through the pine boughs!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Urgh, stop buzzing past our ears like an arrow! Left says roll, right says bank, and bottom gets carsick just watching!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Wait, you three don't steer as one? How do you even dive at an enemy?

say.speaker: combee
say.text: We don't dive like falling rocks. We hover dead level, match six wingbeats to the hum, and hold our lane steady.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hah, fair enough! Looks peaceful until you start snapping Bug Bite at someone's lunch!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Precision beats reckless loops, {name:starly}. Try hovering inside one handspan for three minutes without wobbling!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Bzz... this canyon draft hits flat like a wall! Our rear flank keeps drifting sideways before we can clear the pass!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Don't fight a headwind broadside, {name:combee}! Tuck tight behind my tail feathers and ride my wake!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Whoa! All the roar vanished the instant we slotted behind your wingtips! It feels like calm meadow air!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Solo flyers cut the seam clean! Now match your wingbeats so your whole formation stays level through the turn.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Got it! One, two, three, bank together! Look, we didn't drop an inch!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Now THAT is flying! Half the effort and twice the ground covered!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: We take back half our complaints about show-off flyers, {name:starly}. Just half!

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey, {name:combee}, thanks for screaming about that gravel sling from the left hedge earlier. Never saw it coming mid-dive.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Our rear guard spotted the shadow, our flank heard the brush snap, and the lead shouted! Many eyes beat one reckless streak any day.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Honestly, I always flew like the sky only belonged to one bird at a time. Watching your hive-sync made me rethink how a wing formation works.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: And we used to hug the grass whenever winds turned nasty. Having a spearpoint flyer carve the gale open lets us fight where the squad needs us.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: So here's our sky drill: I punch straight through the front to scatter their archers...

say.speaker: combee
say.text: And we hold the middle draft and watch your tail from every angle! Best air wing in the kingdom!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hup! Two! Three! Four! Nothing clears the morning chill like two hundred palm strikes before breakfast!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Ooh, ooh, let me drill with you, {name:machop}! I've been practicing quick paw jabs back in town!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Now we're talking! Block my right chop with both paws, then snap back fast! Ready? Hup!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Yah! Left parry, right counter! Take that!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: ZAP! Gah! My knuckles just lit up like a lightning rod!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Eep! Sorry, {name:machop}! When I throw a punch too fast, my cheeks dump static straight through my fingertips!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hah! Shook my whole arm awake! Come on, again! Boss Machamp says fighting surprises toughens your guard!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Remember the drill, {name:pawmi}! Keep your palms dry for the parries, then save the spark strictly for the finishing strike!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Locked in! Left block! Right slip! Pivot...

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: And Nuzzle-jab on the wooden post! CRACK!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Whoa! That post jumped an inch out of the dirt! Cleanest snap I've seen all week!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: My paws didn't even fizzle out early! Matching your step gave the jolt way more kick!

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Heavy fist up front, lightning counter right underneath! Wait till those frontier brutes run into our one-two combo!
